turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty relaxed today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I run a small farm and I need about four dry days in a row to make hay. How do I plan that?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Look at the longer range forecasts, and check the national weather service rather than just one app.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but I'm starting a stall at the Saturday market and can only make one bread at first.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exciting. Cinnamon rolls sell fast early on, focaccia suits the lunch crowd. When's the market busiest?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Around eleven.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right in between, then. Sweet or savoury to start?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Stay silent while I talk to Grace, please.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, are you crying? It's a cartoon.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Shut up. The little robot just wanted a friend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Here, have a tissue.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thanks. Don't you dare tell anyone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm telling everyone. Was it the bit with the flower?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Obviously it was the bit with the flower.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I teared up a bit too, honestly.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ha! I knew it. Want to put the next one on?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Phew, that's sorted. I'm back, carry on.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Your stall's first bake was still open. Rolls or focaccia?
